policy.ids: Include valid positive numeric IDs only. Blank-ID draft rows remain pending.
policy.source: Use live Sheets for confirmed gameplay fields. Preserve stable IDs and wiki schema.
exceptions: Chest ID 77 uses HeartwoodCache by explicit project decision; live Chest Sheet still says DryadPineGroveCache.
policy.scope: Wiki covers gameplay data, quest objectives, requirements, stages, rewards, and mechanics; dialogue transcripts are excluded. Source event dialogue fields may remain in underlying stage JSON but are not displayed or localized as a wiki feature.
policy.versioning: Wiki version is independent of game's Ver Log; never claim full game-version parity without completed audit.
include: Main Quest objectives, requirements and rewards
Named, gameplay-relevant Special Events and Missions
Gameplay mechanics, stages, locations and references
exclude: NPC and player dialogue transcripts and option scripts
Raw internal event rows with no standalone gameplay purpose
policy.specialEventClassification: Zero associated quests does not mean universal; keep relevant named encounters. Universal event source rows are intentionally excluded and must not be counted as missing.
